item.title: Meta Collaborates With Media Houses to Strengthen AI Content
item.description: GUWAHATI: Meta has announced new partnerships with major news organisations to integrate real-time news into Meta AI across Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp. The company says the assistant will now provide breaking news, entertainment updates and lifestyle stories when users ask related questions, drawing from outlets such as CNN, Fox News, Le Monde, People and USA Today. item.title: Elderly Woman Dies in Fire Triggered by Short Circuit in Guwahati's Kalapahar

item.title: IndiGo Expects Normal Operations by December 10–15, Says CEO Pieter Elbers
item.description: GUWAHATI: IndiGo is likely to resume normal operations between December 10–15 after a week of strain that peaked on December 5, when chief executive Pieter Elbers also delivered a public apology and acknowledged the scale of the airline’s collapse. The carrier logged more than 1,000 cancellations in a single day, disrupting over half its network and triggering a nationwide backlog. item.title: Assam Relaxes Two-Child Norm for SC, ST, Tea Tribe, Moran and Matak Communities
item.description: GUWAHATI: In a significant policy change, the Assam government on Friday, December 5, relaxed the two-child norm for Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST), tea garden communities, Moran and Matak groups, allowing up to three children for eligibility in government employment, elections and Self Help Group (SHG) incentives. item.title: Bihar Sweep Titles as ASMITA Rugby League (East Zone) Concludes in Guwahati
item.description: GUWAHATI: The East Zone edition of the ASMITA Rugby League concluded on Sunday at the Arjun Bhogeswar Baruah Sports Complex in Guwahati, reinforcing Assam’s growing role as a hub for women’s rugby in the region. The two-day tournament brought together teams from Assam, Bihar, Jharkhand, Odisha and West Bengal, offering valuable match exposure to athletes across three age categories. item.title: Three from Assam Among 25 Dead in Goa Nightclub Fire; Three Arrested
item.description: GUWAHATI: Three persons from Assam lost their lives in a tragic fire incident at a nightclub in Arpora in Goa late Saturday night, December 6. The victims have been identified as Rahul Tanti and Manojit Mal from Cachar district, and Diganta Patir from Dhemaji district.
